descriptionChirho: The ancient city of Jericho, located near the Jordan River in the lower Jordan Valley; in the NT mentioned in connection with Jesus's journey to Jerusalem (healing of blind Bartimaeus, Zacchaeus), and the parable of the Good Samaritan (the road from Jerusalem to Jericho). All 7 occurrences refer to the same geographic location. Multilingual evidence is consistent: Hindi 'yariho', Arabic 'ariha', Korean 'yeorigo', Swahili 'Yeriko', Spanish 'Jericho'. Both clusters differ only in syntactic function (accusative/genitive vs. genitive with preposition), representing case inflection of one proper noun.
